source.section: PDF page 13, Line 13 Pensions (Employer-Funded Pension Plans, items (1) and (2)); Form N-11 line 13; Form N-11 lines 7-12, 19-20 and 23-27 (pages 2-3); PDF page 11 (Line 7), PDF page 20 (Line 23 standard deduction table, Line 25 exemptions), PDF page 9 (Lines 6a, 6b, 'age 65 or over as of January 1, 2026'), PDF page 20 (Line 27 Tax Table), PDF page 50 (2025 Tax Rate Schedules)

worked: Single, 62, retired from the State of Hawaii: Employees' Retirement System pension 45,000 paid upon retirement (no voluntary contributions under an elective right, no 10% federal penalty), part-time wages 20,000. The pension is excluded in full on line 13, item (1); no age, cap or income test. Line 7 federal AGI = wages 20,000.00 + Hawaii Employees' Retirement System pension 45,000.00 = 65,000.00. Federal taxable income = 65,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 49,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 11 total additions = 0.00; line 12 = 65,000.00 + 0.00 = 65,000.00. Line 13 pensions taxed federally but not taxed by Hawaii (public retirement system, item (1)) 45,000.00. Line 19 total subtractions = 45,000.00; line 20 Hawaii AGI = 65,000.00 - 45,000.00 = 20,000.00. Line 23 standard deduction (single, PDF page 20 table) 4,400.00; line 24 = 20,000.00 - 4,400.00 = 15,600.00. Line 6e exemptions: 1 regular = 1; line 25 = 1 x 1,144.00 = 1,144.00. Line 26 taxable income = 15,600.00 - 1,144.00 = 14,456.00. Line 27 tax, Schedule I (PDF page 50) as bands on 14,456.00: 9,600.00 x 1.4% = 134.40; 4,800.00 x 3.2% = 153.60; 56.00 x 5.5% = 3.08; sum = 291.08; tax = 291.08 (Form N-11 line 27 uses the Tax Table below 100,000 of taxable income (PDF page 20, Line 27): the table row 14,450 to 14,500 gives 292; this case uses the bands as numbers). No credits modelled (refundable food/excise and renters credits, lines 28-29, not claimed): state income tax = 291.08.
